name: Codex Exec
description: Run codex exec through a Guardrail-managed wrapper with inline prompt text, input_files prompt context, and structured flag wiring.

guardrail_repo.description: Path to the Guardrail checkout that contains the Codex wrapper helper

prompt.description: Inline prompt text to send to Codex. Fresh approval is required each time.

input_files.description: One or more relative file paths whose contents become tagged prompt blocks. Repeat --input input_files=... to pass multiple files.

sandbox.description: Sandbox mode for Codex shell commands

working_dir.description: Relative working directory Codex should use as its root

add_dirs.description: Comma-separated extra writable directories for Codex

image_files.description: Comma-separated relative image paths to attach to the initial prompt

output_last_message_file.description: Relative path where Codex should write the final assistant message

output_schema_file.description: Relative path to a JSON Schema file for structured final output

oss.description: Use the configured local OSS provider

local_provider.description: Local OSS provider to use when oss=true

skip_git_repo_check.description: Allow Codex to run outside a git repository

ephemeral.description: Run Codex without persisting session files to disk

full_auto.description: Use Codex full-auto mode. Leave sandbox empty when enabled.

lifecycle.description: Session lifecycle intent: start a fresh named session, continue an existing one, or attach to a previously named session. Defaults to 'start'.

session_name.description: Display name and session slot identifier for the Guardrail session contract bound to this run.

session_id.description: Machine-readable session identifier. Optional for 'start'; required for 'continue' and 'attach' when the approved session contract already has one.

steps.description: Build the final prompt payload from inline text and input_files, then invoke codex exec

constraints: Prompt-bearing file inputs are limited to approved relative paths
Prompt-bearing file inputs are content-hash bound at approval time and rechecked before execution
Input files are appended as explicit tagged blocks so the prompt boundary is visible
Guardrail does not provide outer sandboxing for Codex itself; running this recipe outside an external sandbox uses host privileges subject to Codex's own permission model
The wrapper only forwards supported codex exec flags and drops unset parameters
invariants: At least one prompt source must be present before Codex runs
full_auto cannot be combined with an explicit sandbox value
local_provider is only allowed when oss=true
